339-677-1753-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
339-677-1753-8227.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Loot by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6033-6191-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
6033-6191-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Marina Vendrell's Grimoire triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5131-5226-7729--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7729--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {1}
Displacer Kitten and The Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the Vision and Scarlet Witch trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and adding {R}
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1308-4365-6441-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1017-1494-4444-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Wizard Class triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1575-2829-5903.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1812-7420-7546.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {3}{U}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Maestro's Gift resolves, creating a copy of Inspired Skypainter who enters prepared and with haste.
If needed, activate Prismite by paying {R}{R}, adding {U}
Repeat, adding an ever-increasing amount of {R} in step 2.

413-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: Players have two or more cards in hand.
413-6972-7234.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Realm Seekers enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

24-5356-6899.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, choosing an arbitrarily large number and having Wheel of Misfortune deal that much damage to Barbed Servitor instead of you due to With Great Power... if you chose the largest number.
Barbed Servitor triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the damage dealt.
24-5356-6899.notes: If you didn't choose the highest number, Wheel of Misfortune will deal damage to the opponent(s) who did equal to that number.

4934-5078-6747.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

338-2741-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2741-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

3239-5220-5231-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Haywire Mite.
When Haywire Mite dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Haywire Mite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Haywire Mite trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Cast Haywire Mite from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

2438-3440-4867-6809.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice and Scion of Opulence triggers once.
Resolve the Scion of Opulence trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 3.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4055-4929-5455.description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding eight {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Energy Refractor twice by paying {4}, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1357-4697-5942.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana producing permanents, one of which can tap to produce at least {U}.
1357-4697-5942.description:
Cast Twinferno by paying {1}{R}, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast.
Cast Reality Spasm by paying at least {3}{U}{U}, targeting at least three permanents and choosing the untap mode.
Twinferno triggers, copying Reality Spasm, targeting at least three permanents.
Holding priority, activate at least two mana-producing permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, copying the Reality Spasm copy, targeting Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Resolve the copy of Reality Spasm from step 3, untapping Errant and at least two mana-producing permanents you control.
Repeat from step 4.
1357-4697-5942.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} extra when casting Reality Spasm initially. If you choose not to, you will not get infinite untap of permanents or mana from those permanents, unless one of the mana-producing permanents taps to produce two or more mana.

4565-4968-6593.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Ozolith, the Shattered Spire.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4565-4968-6593.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

1-1786-4067-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1786-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

2092-4222-4758-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
2092-4222-4758-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

3944-5220-5618.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling the top two cards of your library, including Blood Pet, with the ability to cast them until your next turn.
Cast Blood Pet from exile by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1349-5256-6012.notablePrerequisites:
There is a coin counter on any creature you control except Athreos.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature if Reluctant Role Model is the only creature you control with a coin counter on it.
1349-5256-6012.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Reluctant Role Model's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a coin counter on it if it wasn't the creature that was sacrificed, or another nontoken creature you control otherwise.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1636-5525-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5525-5996.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
Llanowar Loamspeaker does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5525-5996.description:
Activate Llanowar Loamspeaker's second ability by tapping it, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

586-5011-5147-5406.notablePrerequisites: Cavalier of Night exiled by Dinosaur Headdress.
586-5011-5147-5406.description:
Activate Dinosaur Headdress' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Priest of Gix and causing Priest of Gix to become a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

648-5353.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have a way to give a creature you control haste.
648-5353.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Give the Fractal token haste.
Activate The Pride of Hull Clade by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting the Fractal.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Fractal token.
The Fractal triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its toughness.

1441-3771-4050-5270.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1441-3771-4050-5270.description:
Cast Bill the Pony by paying {W}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Bill the Pony enters the battlefield, it and Samwise trigger.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Bill the Pony trigger, creating two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bill the Pony, adding {W}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Bill the Pony to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2-1651-2499-4306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four devotion to any color.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the largest amount of devotion to a color you have minus four.
2-1651-2499-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value less than the largest amount of devotion to a color you have minus four, this combo nets infinite mana.

1651-3129-4330.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has fought this turn.
1651-3129-4330.description:
Activate Boxing Ring by tapping it, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Boxing Ring.
Repeat.

215-2059.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{W}.
215-2059.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{W}.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {2}{W}.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Village Bell-Ringer to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{W}, this combo nets infinite mana.
